patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks 'who called India quasi-federal' (K.C. Wheare), 'federation with a centralising tendency' (Jennings), 'elephantine size' (H.V. Kamath).
APPSC 'NOT a federal feature' items: Office of the Governor, CAG, 'allocation of financial resources'; Union of India = indissoluble union of States; First Schedule lists territories.
List questions are single-subject: Banking -> Union, Forests -> Concurrent, Higher education not in State List, Entry 64 = institutions of national importance.
Other PSCs favour Railway Police -> State, Economic planning -> Concurrent, Panchayati Raj -> State, Art. 249 Rajya Sabha 2/3 present and voting, 42nd Amendment education transfer.
App MCQs are statement-heavy and add 2026 current-affairs (131st Amendment Bill, TH commentary) and entry-number trivia beyond APPSC depth; core scholar/list facts are well aligned.
